title: [GMCP 203.046.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Property testing, fuzzing, model checking, and continuous red-team
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-046-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: All parsers, serializers, state machines, URI/schema evaluators, policy decisions and transport boundaries have invariant/property tests and coverage-guided fuzz targets with retained regression seeds. Lifecycle, task and subscription models are checked for safety/liveness; threat-model abuse cases map to automated adversarial tests; sanitizer and red-team campaigns report zero unresolved critical/high findings at release. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
